commits.message:
fix(oauth): validate resource in well-known protected resource metadata (#1053)

Apply the RFC 9728 section 3.3 binding check to protected resource metadata fetched from the well-known path, not only to metadata advertised via WWW-Authenticate. A resource that does not bind to the addressed MCP server is rejected instead of being used as the RFC 8707 resource indicator.

Co-authored-by: Friday <friday@mark3labs.com>
